what is a good short sign off for emails
'Best,' or 'Thanks,' are safe. 'Kind regards,' if you want a bit more formality.
how do i stay focused in the afternoon
A short walk, water, and doing your hardest task before lunch.
is a legal assistant the same as a paralegal
Roles overlap and differ by firm. A paralegal usually does substantive legal support work; a legal assistant may focus more on administrative tasks.
